scripts.format: uv run --active ruff format apps packages tests && pnpm --filter @travel/web format
scripts.format:check: uv run --active ruff format --check apps packages tests && pnpm --filter @travel/web format:check
scripts.lint: uv run --active ruff check apps packages tests && pnpm --filter @travel/web lint
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
